meta.name: dot-ai-changelog-fragment
meta.description: Create changelog fragment for release notes. Invoke during /prd-done workflow during the first push to the PR.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为发布说明自动创建变更日志片段
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在每次PR提交时自动生成changelog片段
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create changelog fragments for release notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to auto-generate changelog fragments on every PR push

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在完成 PRD 工作时自动创建 changelog 片段，用于发布说明。它会读取 PRD 文件，提取问题、解决方案和用户影响，然后生成一个 markdown 文件并放入 changelog.d 目录。
howto.when: 在 /prd-done 工作流中，首次推送到 PR 时触发。如果未指定 PRD，Claude 会询问是哪个 PRD。

say.text: 为 PRD-320 创建 changelog 片段。
帮我生成这个 PR 的发布说明。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically creates a changelog fragment for release notes when completing PRD work. It reads the PRD file, extracts problem, solution, and user impact, then generates a markdown file in the changelog.d directory.
howto.when_en: Triggered during the /prd-done workflow on the first push to the PR. If the PRD is not specified, Claude will ask which PRD to use.

say_en.text: Create a changelog fragment for PRD-320.
say_en.note: Claude reads the PRD file and generates the corresponding .feature.md file.

say_en.text: Generate release notes for this PR.
